output.as_of: 2026-11-11; latest reported fiscal year is FY2026, ended May 31, 2026, reported June 10, 2026
output.answer: Oracle's most recent annual revenue is $67.4 billion for fiscal year 2026 (June 2025 - May 2026), up 17% year over year, per its Q4/FY2026 earnings release of June 10, 2026. The Form 10-K puts the exact figure at $67,357 million, versus $57,399 million in fiscal 2025 ($57.4 billion, up 8%). Cloud revenues drove the growth, reaching a record $34.0 billion in FY2026, up 39%.
caveats: Oracle's fiscal year ends May 31, so 'annual revenue' here means fiscal 2026 (June 2025-May 2026); the next annual figure (FY2027) will not be reported until around June 2027.
The $67.4 billion headline figure is rounded; the exact total revenues figure in the FY2026 Form 10-K is $67,357 million.
Figures are as reported on June 10, 2026; Oracle has since reported subsequent quarterly (FY2027) results, but no newer annual figure exists as of November 11, 2026.

passages.quote: Fiscal year 2026 total revenues were up 17% to a record $67.4 billion. Cloud revenues increased 39% to $34.0 billion.

key_facts.fact: Oracle fiscal year 2026 total revenues were $67.4 billion, up 17% year over year (16% constant currency).
Exact FY2026 total revenues per the Form 10-K segment note: $67,357 million, versus $57,399 million in FY2025 and $52,961 million in FY2024.
FY2026 total cloud revenues (IaaS + SaaS) were a record $34.0 billion, up 39% ($18.1B Cloud Infrastructure, up 77%; $15.9B Cloud Applications, up 11%).
Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended May 31, 2026) total revenues were $19.2 billion, up 21% year over year.
